automatic_selection.job: docs/training/plan-20260927/c08/jobs/C08-r2-select.json: priority 23, requires C08-arm-lr3e-5, one-shot, about 5 minutes
automatic_selection.receipt: ~/.local/state/sepalith/campaign-20260915/C08-r2-selection.json (an earlier receipt is kept as C08-r2-selection.superseded-<time>.json)
automatic_selection.binding_checks: For each arm: the bound recipe's arm name and learning rate; the C08 job file carries --recipe <that recipe, same sha256> and --stop-after-gate 268 and is in done/ with the same command; the last decision-step-268-<n>.json has the decision schema, step 268, bound_recipe_sha256 = the recipe's sha256, evaluation_complete, decided_by rule_R1, no override, a first-gate R1 record without problems whose inputs equal the metrics, an outcome that matches the R1 floor recomputed here, DEV75 and DEV250 result files with matching sha256, and a checkpoint-268 manifest with the evaluated sha256 that is the latest durable checkpoint. The winner also needs dev-gate-step-268.json. Across arms: identical parent, seed, data_queue, panels, generation runtime and parent baseline metrics. Anything else is stop-for-user.
automatic_selection.rule: R2 as written: drop arms failing the R1 first-gate floor; highest score250; if the top two (counting ties for second) are within 5, the lower learning rate; if still tied, the lower CPT 2K validation loss, which the decisions do not record, so that step is stop-for-user; no survivor is stop-for-user.
automatic_selection.on_winner: Enqueues C09-arm-a-<lr> through sepalith.ops.night_queue (under queue.lock): the winner's C08 job without --stop-after-gate 268, resumable, about 240 minutes, priority 24, requires C07-baseline, C08-arm-<lr> and C08-r2-select. night_arm then resumes from checkpoint-268 through gates 536, 803 and 1,071 under R1. A retry with an identical job already queued is accepted; any other C09-arm-a-* job is stop-for-user.
automatic_selection.exit_codes: 0 winner enqueued; 3 stop-for-user (the night report lists the question under Needs the user); anything else is an error

runner_behaviour_verified.requires: select() re-reads the queue before every start; a job whose requirement is pending or deferred is skipped as waiting_for_requirements for that pass only and stays in pending/.
runner_behaviour_verified.mid_night_enqueue: A job that another job enqueues during the night is picked up by the same runner on its next pass (tests, and a real night_runner CLI run in ~/.local/state/sepalith/night-dryrun-20261012-c08-r2b).
runner_behaviour_verified.lr3e-5_deferred_again: The selector stays in pending/ (waiting_for_requirements), the runner stops with no_eligible_job, and both run on the next night.
runner_behaviour_verified.lr3e-5_failed: The selector is skipped as requires_failed_job and stays in pending/; the report lists the lr3e-5 failure under Needs the user. After night_queue retry C08-arm-lr3e-5, both run.

automatic_selection.projection_on_current_numbers: lr1e-5 (110) beats lr3e-6 (104) by 6, outside the band of 5. lr3e-5 wins only with score250 >= 116 and the R1 floor passed. With 111 to 115 it is within 5 of lr1e-5, so the lower learning rate, lr1e-5, wins. With 110 or less, or if lr3e-5 fails the floor, lr1e-5 wins.
